title: …. All annotations from 'expect' declaration '…' must be present and have the same arguments on 'actual' declaration '…', otherwise they might behave incorrectly.

title: 'actual' function cannot have default argument values. They must be declared in the 'expect' function.

title: Ignorability statuses for 'expect' and 'actual' declarations are different. 'expect' declaration … is '…' and 'actual' declaration … is '…'. Different statuses may result in inconsistent and incorrect warnings.
message_templates: Ignorability statuses for 'expect' and 'actual' declarations are different. 'expect' declaration {} is '{}' and 'actual' declaration {} is '{}'. Different statuses may result in inconsistent and incorrect warnings.

title: Right-hand side of 'actual' type alias must be a class, not another type alias.
